usedFor: Eventix holds the events, shops and locations behind ticket sales, and LeadConnector receives them as contacts, tags or workflow entries.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event” in Eventix, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: The action updates the contact if it already exists, so a repeat run does not add a duplicate.

watchOut: Eventix triggers such as “Update Shop” poll on a schedule, so a short delay before LeadConnector changes is normal.
